desc: If the stone is touching the ground, you can use an action to speak the stone's command word and summon an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.sApYLZj9PTZ40wJr]{Earth Elemental}, as if you had cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.1LkZvINag7KqBmDR]{Conjure Elemental} spell. The stone can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
name: stone of controlling earth elementals
